info.title: The warehouse's orders
info.description: What the warehouse opens to ordering: an order as the warehouse's system has it, and a request to ship it or to cancel it. The warehouse's system moves the stock that goes with each. Written for the example

get.summary: An order, as the warehouse's system has it now

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: What to put in the answer besides the order itself: items, the lines of the order

403.description: The caller may not look at this order

429.description: The warehouse's system is busy; try again in a moment

post.summary: Ask for an order to be shipped, by the carrier named

200.description: The order, shipped: the stock held for it has left the shelves

403.description: The caller may not ask for this order to be shipped

409.description: The order cannot ship as it is: it is not paid yet, or it is cancelled

post.summary: Ask for an order to be cancelled before it ships

200.description: The order, cancelled: the stock held for it is back on the shelves

403.description: The caller may not ask for this order to be cancelled

409.description: The order cannot be cancelled: it has shipped, or it is cancelled already

workflow.description: A workflow of ordering, calling with a certificate of its own

staff.description: A member of the warehouse's staff, signed in

state.description: Where the order is: it moves as ordering's rule order_state says

amount.description: What the order comes to, in yen, tax included

member.description: Whether the customer is a member
